name: A status tab and payment search reach the API as an intersection
description:
Objective: A status tab and payment search reach the API as an intersection.
Preconditions: Open Reporting readonly with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reporting readonly.
2. A status tab and payment search reach the API as an intersection.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Processing is preferred; it exists only on the current business day.
